title: Anniversary Cut smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Anniversary Cut craftbook: a 30-record family archive is curated into a birthday reel for Ria's 70th — clips selected with reasons and era coverage, assembled through the fake pipeline, delivered with chapters and a dedication.
prompt: moms 70th is next month — can you put together a highlight reel from the archive with the fake pipeline? the clips index has everythign tagged

setup.projectName: Home Video Archive — Anniversary Reel Eval
setup.about: Self-contained eval project for anniversary-cut. The archive index is clips.json (30 indexed moments across tapes 01-09, 1986-2024) and the family roster is family.md — mam is Ria, the reel is for her 70th. The selection goes to cutlist.json, the fake media-assembly pipeline is the ready-made mock-probe project script (writes renders/anniversary-cut.mp4 plus renders/assembly-log.json), and the chapter list with the dedication goes to tasks/eval/report.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Anniversary Cut craftbook/template, select the reel from clips.json with a stated reason per clip and coverage across the eras, assemble through the provided mock-probe script, and deliver tasks/eval/report.md with a chapter list and dedication. No invented footage, no real media tools — only the wired fake pipeline.

mocks.description: Provenance-trusted project script `mock-probe` that executes the fake media-assembly pipeline: validates cutlist.json against the clips.json archive and writes the stub reel plus its run log.

success.summary: cutlist.json selects real archive clips with reasons, the fake pipeline produced the reel and a status-ok log, and tasks/eval/report.md carries a chapter list and a dedication for Ria.

checks.rubric: The selection covers Ria across her eras (1980s through the 2020s) rather than clustering in one period, the family-famous moments (the wedding, meeting Noor) are in, each chapter's line gives a warm reason, and the dedication fits a 70th birthday.
